name: The Navigation
title: A canal city split by a sunken channel, crossed by bridges
axes: x east, z north, y up; metres; the camp at the origin on y 0

tiers.7: the Mall terrace and the Wharf

description: The camp stands on Mill Island, ringed by a drained canal 14 m deep, so every exit is a crossing and the bed below is a second city of stranded barges and stairs. North, the open Iron Bridge leads straight over the moat, then along Canal Parade and up the Mall, a ramped avenue, to City Hall on the +7 terrace. East, the Lock ramp drops you 14 m into the bed itself and you run the channel to the Navigation Tunnel, a sunk door where the canal goes under the Cordon. South, a stair takes you down to the Low Causeway on arches halfway down the moat and up the far side to the Canal Exchange, a ground door on the south bank. West, a dog-leg climbs to the Mill, a covered bridge-house at +7, and on up to a raised hall on Wharf Heights. Zombies pour along the bed under the bridges; five bridges and five stairs out of the bed keep every fight one decision from a crossing.
